✨ NEW OLD STOCK • SZ MIRAGE • SWISS MADE 🇨🇭

A rare find from the golden era of Swiss quartz watches.

Presenting our SZ Mirage NOS Collection — original New Old Stock pieces preserved from decades ago and now available at Mainspring.

SZ Mirage was a Swiss watch brand associated with Sedco S.A. of Marin, Neuchâtel, with the MIRAGE trademark registered in 1980. The brand also had documented activity in the Middle East during the early 1980s, making these pieces especially interesting for collectors in the Gulf.

Our collection features distinctive period designs including:
✨ Elegant Swiss quartz movements
✨ Two-tone & black/gold bracelets
✨ Roman numeral and patterned dials
✨ Slim vintage dress-watch cases
✨ Genuine untouched NOS condition
✨ Authentic 1980s Swiss character

These are not modern reproductions — they are surviving unused examples from the period, offering a small piece of Swiss watch history.

⌚ Several SZ Mirage NOS watches now available in stock

✨ NEW OLD STOCK — CENTURY SWISS WATCHES 🇨🇭

A rare selection of NOS Century watches, preserved in beautiful original condition and now available from our collection.

NOS means New Old Stock — vintage watches that were never previously worn or sold to an end customer.

Known for its distinctive Swiss design, elegant finishing and jewellery-like approach to watchmaking, Century created pieces that look unlike almost anything else on the wrist. Selected models feature the brand’s signature faceted sapphire cases, giving them an unmistakable vintage character. 💎⌚
